generatedFromSchema_doNotEdit.title: Entity FreezeOnHitSubcomponentDefinition
generatedFromSchema_doNotEdit.description: Freezes nearby water blocks to ice in a configurable volume around the impact (Education Edition chemistry feature).

fields.title: Shape
fields.description: Shape of the freezing volume. Allowed values: `cube`, `sphere`.

fields.title: Size
fields.description: Half-extent of the freezing volume (in blocks).

fields.title: Snap To Block
fields.description: If `true`, the freezing volume is centered on the hit block's center instead of the precise impact point.
